brief.title: Create once. Review. Publish.
brief.narration: Start with a clear message. Create your video, watch every scene and listen to the narration. Approve the exact file and its destinations. The workflow delivers the original video and keeps each publishing receipt, so interrupted jobs can resume without uploading duplicates.
brief.caption: Video production with exact-file approval and durable publishing receipts.

scenes.title: Start with a clear message
scenes.body: Create a structured brief and choose the intended destinations.

scenes.title: Review the complete video
scenes.body: Check every scene, the voiceover and the final caption.

scenes.title: Approve and deliver
scenes.body: Keep the original file and recover incomplete channel delivery.
